system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: underground caves and tunnels. Glowmoss grows as soft green cushions in caves where running water carries traces of unusual minerals. In darkness it shines with a cold yellow light, brightening noticeably when touched or disturbed. Prepared with clear resin, the crushed moss becomes a sticky luminous paste favoured by miners, shrine-keepers and underground scouts. It adheres to stone, wood or metal and shines as brightly as a torch for 1 hour. Covering the treated surface blocks the light, and water does not extinguish it. On the sheet: The paste is on the surface it was applied to; covering it blocks the light, and water does not extinguish it. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
